title: Development cohort and inference limits
text: The frozen development cohort has 3,413 windows: 6 positive and 3,407 benign. Adjacent positive windows come from one correlated campaign/source. These are not independent attacks or a final holdout. Neither this benchmark nor an agent investigation establishes production detection effectiveness or confirmed compromise.

title: Clock policy and unknown observations
text: The active original CIC-IDS2017 Tuesday source uses a strict unrepaired morning clock. Temporally ineligible observations are not scored. Unscored is a role, not a benign label. Do not invent repaired timestamps or treat excluded traffic as clean.

title: Investigation evidence and retrospective labels
text: Alert retrieval ranks within one detector without using labels. Window/flow inspection may show retrospective benchmark annotations for auditing. A benchmark attack label is not a live confirmed compromise. No host blocking, incident response, attribution or changes are performed by this assistant.

title: Latency and model selection
text: Pipeline timing includes preprocessing; model_only excludes it. Batch 1 has 60 warm CPU calls; larger batches have 25. P95 is descriptive, not an SLA or confidence bound. Compare quality and false alerts alongside latency. SQL controls have no invented model-call timings. Agent response latency is measured separately from detector inference latency.

title: XGBoost serialization and score ties
text: XGBoost has two distinct development scores and a largest tie of 3,409/3,413 (99.883%). Saved float32 score text must be restored to float32 before float64 threshold comparison. Its saved calibration_false_alerts field is defective and excluded for every model. Random forest also has high tie concentration. A narrow development result is not a production winner certificate.

title: Three-source audit and reporting lineage
text: Original CIC-IDS2017 Tuesday is active. Corrected CIC-IDS2017 is a candidate audited separately with different full-day clock and label policies. UNSW-NB15 was documentation-only; unmeasured quality is unknown, not zero defects. The agent and Power BI use the same explicit immutable report bundle and benchmark identity; source-audit evidence is not model performance on that source.
